messages.subject: [R-sig-phylo] Rooting a tree with ape
messages.body_plain:
Dear list,

How do I root a tree with ape? Please reply to the list or to me
(jane.roe at uni-example.edu). My notes are available at www.example.org/phylo
and the code at github.com/example/rooting.

Jane

> How do I root a tree with ape? Please reply to the list or to me
> (jane.roe at uni-example.edu).

Use root() with an outgroup. Lee Vane <lee.vane@lab-example.net> wrote
about this last year. I have moved: m@rk@poe @end|ng |rom |n@t-ex@mp|e@org
is my address now.

Mark
